setup: The triangle is a right triangle with a 30 degree angle, so its sides are in the ratio \(1 : \sqrt{3} : 2\).

steps.say: The shortest leg is the one opposite the 30 degree angle, which is \([[short_leg]]\) here. Identify that side first, because the ratio is defined from it.
The hypotenuse is twice the shortest leg, so it is \([[hypotenuse]]\). The long leg would be the short one times the square root of 3, which is where an irrational answer would come from.

answer: So the sides here are a short leg of \([[short_leg]]\) and a hypotenuse of \([[hypotenuse]]\).
